name: Cutting Table
description: The central atelier station where fabric bolts are unfurled, paper patterns are arranged along the grain, and precision shears cut out structural dress components.
source: Official Steam store description and developer gameplay mechanics (Free Lives / Cozy Lives)
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

The Cutting Table is the fundamental workstation in Dressmaker where yardage is prepared. Players lay down digital or paper pattern pieces over bolts of cloth. The grain line arrows (pointing horizontally left/right) must be aligned until a green outline confirms correct orientation, preventing quality score caps. Players arrange pattern pieces efficiently to minimize fabric waste just like in a real studio.

Tactical Application

Always place your largest structural panels—such as full skirts and front bodices—first, then tuck smaller sleeves, collars, and cuffs into the negative spaces like a game of Tetris to minimize fabric waste.

stats.Confirmed: Pattern nesting, grain-line orientation, green outline feedback

name: Sewing Machine
description: The high-precision assembly station where cut panels are pinned, aligned, and stitched together along dotted guide lines to produce a finished wearable garment.
source: Official Steam store page and developer patch notes (Free Lives / Cozy Lives)
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

The Sewing Machine controls the stitch quality evaluation. Players guide the assembled panels under the needle following dotted seam lines (Space to sew forward, A/D to rotate fabric, W/S to adjust needle speed). Sewing accuracy directly dictates the final 100% Quality Score. The game provides a Sewing Assist toggle in the settings menu to constrain needle drift around tight corners, and Build 410 added thread spool selection to change thread colour.

Tactical Application

Decelerate needle feed before reaching curves and sharp corners. Rushing through seams creates drift errors that penalize final client appraisal scores.

stats.Confirmed: Manual feed, needle speed control, Sewing Assist toggle, thread spool picker

name: Sketchbook Drafting Desk
description: The atelier planning desk where dress designs are conceptualized, coloured, and personalized before cutting out fabric.
source: Official Steam store announcement and Prototype 0.5.5 documentation
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

The Sketchbook allows players to design and colour dresses, combining silhouette elements like bodices, sleeves, and skirts while applying fabric samples and decorative appliqué before cutting.

Tactical Application

Use the sketchbook to explore silhouette combinations that fulfill the client's event and personal preferences. Test out palette harmonies with fabric samples before moving to the cutting table.

stats.Confirmed: Silhouette combination, fabric sample testing, colour design

name: Mannequin Display Stand
description: A dressmaker form used to preview cut pattern pieces, fit completed garments for customers, and display ready-to-wear dresses for off-the-rack sales.
source: Official Steam store description (Free Lives / Cozy Lives)
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

The Mannequin Display acts as the fitting and preview checkpoint. Cut patterns can be draped on the mannequin before sewing, and finished dresses can be inspected before customer delivery. Pre-made designs can also be displayed in your shop window and sold off-the-rack for coin and reputation.

Tactical Application

Inspect button and trim alignment from multiple angles before handing off the garment. Ensure accessories match client preferences or create striking display pieces for your storefront.

stats.Confirmed: Pre-sewing pattern preview, final fit inspection, off-the-rack sales

name: Cotton Textile Bolt
description: A reliable, versatile plain-weave natural textile with moderate drape and high tear resistance, suitable for daywear and everyday commissions.
source: Developer press kit and gameplay material manifests (Cozy Lives)
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

Cotton represents the baseline commercial textile in Dressmaker. It is cost-effective, easy to cut along the grain with clear horizontal alignment, and universally accepted for casual, domestic, and everyday client orders.

Tactical Application

Use cotton for early commissions when working capital is tight. Remember during the tutorial to reserve funds for required accessories rather than spending all coin on fabric bolts.

name: Linen Textile Bolt
description: A structured, breathable flax textile characterized by distinct grain lines and crisp folding behavior, highly valued for outdoor and relaxed briefs.
source: Developer press kit and gameplay material manifests (Cozy Lives)
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

Linen features pronounced grain lines that make horizontal alignment visually clear on the cutting table. Rotating the piece until the green outline appears ensures a 100% quality rating.

Tactical Application

Ideal for client briefs specifying lightweight, summer, or relaxed styles. Follow the dotted seam lines steadily and decelerate around curved hemlines.

name: Silk Charmeuse Bolt
description: A high-luster, fluidly draping luxury textile reserved for high-stakes formal and celebratory event commissions.
source: Developer press kit and official Steam screenshots (Free Lives / Cozy Lives)
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

Silk is one of the five core confirmed fabric types (alongside cotton, linen, wool, and velvet). It carries high aesthetic value in the atelier catalog, providing fluid drape and refined sheen.

Tactical Application

Recommended for formal evening wear and celebratory event dresses. Enable Sewing Assist in settings if needle drift occurs on long sweeping seams.

name: Lace Trim & Edging
description: Intricate openwork lace used to edge hems, cuffs, and necklines, fulfilling specific decorative and client accent requests.
source: Official Steam store description and gameplay materials
body:
What Official Sources Confirm

Decorations in Dressmaker include buttons, bows, appliqué, and lace trims, which can be placed wherever players like with complete creative freedom.

Tactical Application

Carefully align lace borders along curved hems and necklines. In the tutorial, ensure you budget enough coin to purchase required trim pieces before cutting.
